title: Fourier norm of a self-convolution
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, and let $f:(\mathbb F_2)^n\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $|f(x)|=1$ for every $x$. Form the normalized convolution $f*f$ on $(\mathbb F_2)^n$, and view it as a function on the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$ through the coordinatewise correspondence between bits and signs. Its Fourier one norm, the sum of the absolute values of all its Fourier coefficients, is $1$.
